title: sooshitsu wo kakaete, nao ikiro
text:
「 喪失を抱えて、なお生きろ 」
Sooshitsu wo kakaete, nao ikiro
Live, embracing the loss. 

Shun noooooooooooooooooooooo. Y-you appeared so little in the movie, I want more moments with Shun!!....and Shin. He's so huggaaaablee  
My new favourite movie, by one of my biggest inspirations ever, Shinkai Makoto!!   

Hoshi wo Ou Kodomo is such a lovely and inspiring-themed movie.  I love such settings the most.  
I didn't use a reference, kind of put together some elements from memory. I watched it 4 times already.
It was strange and unexpected how his skies have stuck in my head/heart??  Since I watched Kumo no Mukou, Yakusoku no basho, my whole world has definitely changed.   I thought nothing can compare with the beauty of the real sky, but Shinkai Makoto's worlds have an extreme beauty, different but just as beautiful as the real sky.    

I still can't believe the negative critiques this movie is receiving.  It's not "too light", it's just different. The characters are few, but totally loved the time with them.  It's a story that has both sadness, happiness and loss, somehow peaceful but full of meaning, certainly trying to tell something. 
One of my goals is to improve at backgrounds.  I put too many catchy colours, leaving out important grays, blues etc. I will try a bit calmer colours in the next practices. ... 

huhuhu now that my mac is healthy and all, I can drawww !!//jumps to practice//
